name: Medieval Mania: A LEGO Real-Time Strategy Game
author: ProfessorBrickkeeper
description:
The kingdom has been destroyed and it's up to you to fix it! Guide your brave band of knights through multiple stages of resource gathering and building as you race against the clock to restore peace to that land.

This proof-of-concept was created over the course of several weeks using the LEGO Microgame as a base, with the addition of original code and artwork.

My LEGO Ideas username is ProfessorBrickkeeper.

While this game has been tested on multiple hardware configurations, some users may still encounter issues running the game on lower-end devices. A standalone version of the game will be made available in the comments shortly.
